mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
"type" "businessNo" "ceo" "industry" "contactName" "phone" "taxEmail" "projectCount" "personCount" "useYn" "leaderName" "profitRate" "salesExpenseAmount" "effectiveMonth" "name"
DESCASC NULLS LAST, "id" ASC
mapper.select:
SELECT c.clnt_id AS "id", t.code_nm AS "type", c.clnt_nm AS "name", c.biz_reg_no AS "businessNo", c.ceo_nm AS "ceo", i.code_nm AS "industry", c.chrg_nm AS "contactName", c.telno AS "phone", c.tax_email_addr AS "taxEmail", c.acct_no_enc AS "encryptedAccount", b.code_nm AS "bankName", counts.projects AS "projectCount", counts.people AS "personCount", c.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_bs_clnt c LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code t ON t.code_grp_id='CLNT_TYPE' AND t.code=c.clnt_type_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code i ON i.code_grp_id='INDUTY' AND i.code=c.induty_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code b ON b.code_grp_id='BANK' AND b.code=c.bank_cd CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT a.proj_id) AS projects, count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) AS people FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt <= #{basisDate} AND a.input_end_dt >= #{basisDate} AND p.proj_stat_cd IN ('ING','PRE') AND ((c.clnt_type_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') AND p.cust_clnt_id=c.clnt_id) OR (c.clnt_type_cd IN ('VNDR','BOTH') AND d.blng_clnt_id=c.clnt_id)) ) counts
AND c.clnt_type_cd='BOTH' AND c.clnt_type_cd IN (#{filters.type},'BOTH')
AND c.use_yn=#{filters.useYn} AND (strpos(c.clnt_nm,#{filters.q}) > 0 OR strpos(replace(c.biz_reg_no,'-',''),replace(#{filters.q},'-','')) > 0)

SELECT p.part_id AS "id", p.part_nm AS "name", u.user_nm AS "leaderName", s.prft_dstrb_rt AS "profitRate", s.sales_exps_amt AS "salesExpenseAmount", substr(s.aply_bgn_ym,1,4)||'-'||substr(s.aply_bgn_ym,5,2) AS "effectiveMonth", substr(f.aply_bgn_ym,1,4)||'-'||substr(f.aply_bgn_ym,5,2) AS "futureMonth", fu.user_nm AS "futureLeader", f.prft_dstrb_rt AS "futureRate", f.sales_exps_amt AS "futureAmount", (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.dev_id) FROM tb_hr_dev d WHERE d.part_id=p.part_id) AS "personCount", (SELECT count(DISTINCT r.proj_id) FROM tb_pj_proj r JOIN tb_pj_proj_part pp ON pp.proj_id=r.proj_id WHERE r.proj_stat_cd IN ('ING','PRE') AND pp.part_id=p.part_id AND pp.aply_bgn_ym=(SELECT max(pp2.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_pj_proj_part pp2 WHERE pp2.proj_id=r.proj_id AND pp2.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month})) AS "projectCount", p.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_bs_part p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT st.* FROM tb_bs_part_std st WHERE st.part_id=p.part_id AND st.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (st.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR st.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY st.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=s.part_ldr_user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT st.* FROM tb_bs_part_std st WHERE st.part_id=p.part_id AND st.aply_bgn_ym > #{month} ORDER BY st.aply_bgn_ym LIMIT 1) f ON true LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user fu ON fu.user_id=f.part_ldr_user_id WHERE p.hq_yn='N' AND p.use_yn=#{filters.useYn} AND strpos(p.part_nm,#{filters.q}) > 0
